kind: Step5 seam5 closed batches; remaining queue and independent semantic review pending

rules.s5-coverage: Closed batch retains all original identities and remaining queue/carries exactly once.
rules.s5-lexical: Every pinned whole-file docs-root token has its own physical reference span.
rules.s5-pins: Every input digest/mode/byte count matches its own immutable git pin.
rules.s5-spans: Every literal, passage, operation and full enclosing test callback matches pinned bytes.
rules.s5-inheritance: Step4 source slots retain exact identity/disposition and complete prior record hash.
rules.s5-patches: Complete source and golden diffs apply and reverse exactly, without additional substitutions.
rules.s5-atomic: Source 31/48 and full expected golden 198/215 co-cut; complete rendered bytes equal at both sides.
rules.s5-receipts: Source/candidate hashes, full specs and required comparison fields join one honest pending receipt.
rules.s5-review: Only admitted/judgment items are window obligations; mechanical rejects remain separately enumerated.
rules.r19-label-diagnostic: Only an assert.ok diagnostic label, in a complete census-root-free callback with no traced census constant, can be rejected mechanically.
rules.a-passage-agreement: All pairs of overlapping operation intervals on the same line/passage agree in admission and effective disposition; independent adjacent expressions have distinct source intervals.
rules.b-real-blocker: R12: no boilerplate dependency shared after quoted operands, paths, IDs and line numbers are normalized; copies join their source passage; serialized state rows use their accepted per-file input dependency.
rules.c-render-owner: Every generated source-copy reference/tuple derives its disposition from the exact source owner; a park cites an actually parked source owner.
rules.d-own-operand: Each admitted dynamic tuple has its exact document-yielding sub-expression pathOperand in its pinned passage; every rejection names a closed R5 nonDocumentUse category.
rules.e-retired-successor: Preserved retired decision citations carry a live successorNote with a real heading anchor.
rules.r11-plans-boundary: R11: an operation rooted only in plans/** is rejected as plans-report-artifact; trace pinned declarations and imported constants, not adjacent context.
rules.j-coverage: Every closed real-reader file retains all its census references and original tuples once.
rules.j-pins: Full source files, real read inputs and target claims are bound to immutable pin/mode/hash.
rules.j-spans: All original spans, passages and actual operation operands are exact pinned text.
rules.j-claims: Patches conserve exact headings in live claim regions; no missing claim is supplied by a summary.
rules.j-search: Every park carries complete pinned alias and four-root target-search evidence.
rules.j-patches: Whole-file forward/inverse diffs and complete co-cut greps match only declared pointer deltas.
rules.j-receipts: No candidate output or proof is claimed; receipt current/candidate input metadata and pending obligations match.
rules.j-review: Every admitted or judgment-rejected item is included in the independent review list.
